title: Five linked events on reservations and checkouts
lede: Reservation and checkout event linking now stays usable through five scheduled events without changing primary-event or custody behavior.

stats.n: Same iPhone 16 Pro / iOS 26.5 picker and fixture data
API, draft, web, and native boundaries reject or disable above five

sections.heading: Native picker at capacity
sections.note: Matched before/after captures use the same fixture, device, OS, and interaction script.

pairs.title: Five-event selection state
pairs.sub: The first five scheduled events are selected in both captures.
pairs.beforeCap: Baseline: the fourth and later options are dimmed after three selections.
pairs.afterCap: Current: the fourth and fifth options remain selectable and selected.

changes.h: The third-event ceiling moved to five
changes.was: The native picker and surrounding booking flows stopped accepting links after three events.
changes.now: Reservation creation, checkout handoff/relinking, drafts, web pickers, and native selection now share the five-event boundary.

changes.h: Primary-event and custody behavior stayed stable
changes.was: Existing primary-event compatibility and kiosk custody boundaries were at risk of becoming implicit side effects of the cap change.
changes.now: The junction model, primary event, gear lifecycle, and direct kiosk event-or-purpose custody path are unchanged.

verification: 121 focused Vitest tests pass across six booking, route, draft, and iOS contract suites.
Web: TypeScript, lint, and npm run build:app pass.
Native: iPhone 16 Pro / iOS 26.5 build and matched before/after UI captures pass.
Web visual capture: deferred because no authenticated local runtime was available; the web boundary is covered by source, focused tests, and build checks.
Docs verification: npm run verify:docs passes after codemap regeneration.
notes: Direct kiosk checkout entry remains its existing single event-or-purpose custody path; shared reservation-to-checkout handoff and active-booking relinking support five linked events.
The source slice shipped in production deployment dpl_9cFHwpSQA9QjsQTV3GF3uKf65QtE from commit c48dd43d; direct kiosk custody remains unchanged.
